title: Taking the PULSE of Enterprise Workflows: Evaluating Persistent Project-State Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.28374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enterprise agents must maintain an up-to-date understanding of work distributed across heterogeneous artifacts, evolving over time, and unevenly visible to different collaborators. We formulate this challenge as persistent project-state understanding (PPSU) and introduce PULSE, a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories. PULSE constructs deterministic, time-indexed project state and documented collaborator views from source-linked records, and evaluates three families of questions: open loops, project evolution, and view gaps. Across retrieval agents, graph- and memory-augmented retrieval, long-context, and oracle conditions, we find substantial headroom for current systems. Retrieval and extraction account for the largest share of the gap, but providing explicit project state on top of gold evidence yields further substantial gains, showing that PPSU cannot be reduced to retrieval alone. translated_title: 把脉企业工作流：评估持久性项目状态理解
translated_abstract: 企业智能体必须对分布在异构工件中、随时间不断演变、且对不同协作者可见程度不均的工作保持最新理解。我们将这一挑战形式化为持久性项目状态理解，并引入PULSE，一个包含1,573个问题、覆盖30个企业项目历史记录的基准。PULSE从带源链接的记录中构建确定性的、按时间索引的项目状态以及有文档记录的协作者视图，并评估三类问题：未闭合事项、项目演变和视图差距。在检索智能体、图增强与记忆增强检索、长上下文以及oracle条件下，我们发现当前系统仍有巨大的提升空间。检索和抽取占据了差距的最大份额，但在金标准证据之上再提供显式项目状态能带来进一步的显著收益，这表明PPSU不能被简化为单纯的检索问题。进一步的分析显示
tldr: 本文提出了持久性项目状态理解（PPSU）任务及PULSE基准（包含1,573个问题、覆盖30个企业项目历史），实验发现检索与抽取是当前系统的主要瓶颈，但即使在完美证据之上仍需显式项目状态才能取得进一步提升，证明该任务无法简化为单纯的检索问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PPSU (persistent project-state understanding) and PULSE, a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories, showing that retrieval and extraction are the largest bottlenecks for current systems, yet explicit project state yields further gains on top of gold evidence, demonstrating PPSU cannot be reduced to retrieval alone.
